title: 九上 · 证据与表达训练卷
scope: 被动语态、宾语从句、定语从句、主谓一致与跨句推断；原创笔试能力训练。
language: The old stage [[1]] by local workers last month.
stage 是维修的承受者，last month 对应一般过去时被动 was repaired。
单用 repaired 在这里会把舞台当成实施维修的主语。
has repaired 是主动完成时，且不符合明确结束的 last month。
where does the school bus stop
宾语从句用陈述语序，主语 the school bus 为单数，动词用 stops。
不能在这里保留直接问句的助动词倒装。
语序虽像陈述句，但单数主语后需要 stops。
The student [[1]] notebook was missing has found it.
从句中 notebook 前缺表示所属关系的词，用 whose。
who 不直接修饰 notebook 来表示谁的。
which 在这里也不能表达学生与笔记本的所属关系。
Since September, the number of books on this shelf [[1]] grown.
主语中心是单数 number，Since September 提示与现在相连，用 has grown。
books 在介词短语中，不能让谓语误用 have。
are 不能与这里的 grown 构成所需的现在完成时。
These photographs [[1]] in the hall next week.
照片承受展出动作，将来被动是 will be displayed。
will display 是主动结构，不能表达照片将被展出。
will be displaying 是主动进行结构，不是这里的被动。
The poster [[1]] by our class won a small prize.
poster 与 design 是被动关系，过去分词短语 designed by ... 作后置修饰。
designing 表主动进行等关系，不符合后面的 by our class。
design 原形不能直接构成这里的被动修饰短语。
The notice says visitors must not [[1]] the objects.
must not 后接动词原形，表示禁止触碰。
情态动词后不用第三人称单数 touches。
The guide gave Mei and [[1]] a copy of the route.
Mei and me 一起作 gave 的宾语，需要宾格 me。
不能因与名字并列就把宾语位置的代词改为主格 I。
my 需修饰名词，不能在这里直接表示收到路线的人。

cloze.text: For a display about our neighbourhood, our group found a photograph of an old bridge. A message below it said the photograph was taken a hundred years ago. We almost copied that date onto a label. Then Yun asked where the 〔1〕_____ came from. The page gave no reference, so we searched the local archive's public catalogue. It listed the same photograph, with a date thirty years later. We did not simply decide that the first message was 〔2〕_____ because it was online. Instead, we compared the records and noted which source supported each date. The archive also explained that its date was an estimate. Our label therefore used 'around' before the year. That small word made the statement more 〔3〕_____. We kept a record of the source so visitors could check it. A clear label does not need to sound completely 〔4〕_____ when the evidence is limited. It should help readers understand both what is known and what remains 〔5〕_____.
items: date
colour
visitor
We almost copied that date onto a label.
Yun追问的是准备抄到标签上的年份依据。
这里没有追查照片颜色的来源。
visitor 是参观者，不是前文提到的年份信息。
wrong
free
recent
we compared the records and noted which source supported each date.
他们通过比较核对，没有只因信息在线就判定它错误。
是否免费与年份真伪不是同一个判断。
原文比较的是年份依据，并未因在线就认定消息最近发布。
accurate
dramatic
permanent
its date was an estimate.
估计年份前加 around，能更准确地表达证据的确定程度。
增加戏剧性不是如实使用估计词的作用。
around 不会让年份或标签成为永久不变的事实。
certain
expensive
silent
when the evidence is limited.
证据有限时，不应把表述写得绝对确定。
昂贵与文字表达的确定程度无关。
silent 不符合标签向读者传达信息的功能。
uncertain
finished
copied
both what is known
known 与 uncertain 对照，区分已知和未确定内容。
finished 表完成，不是此处与已知信息对应的确定程度。
copied 表复制，没有回应证据尚未确定的范围。

reading.text:
STUDENT ENERGY CHECK: FIRST REPORT
For three school days, six volunteers checked empty classrooms after the final lesson. They recorded lights that were still on, but did not measure electricity use. On Monday they found lights on in eight rooms; on Tuesday, five; on Wednesday, four. A reminder card was put beside each classroom switch on Tuesday morning. The team has not yet shown that the cards caused the fall. Different clubs used the rooms on different days, and some volunteers reminded classmates in person. The next check will record room use as well as the lights. The report recommends keeping the cards for now and checking again, rather than announcing a percentage reduction in electricity. Any estimate of energy saved would need more information.
items: What did the volunteers record?
Empty classrooms with lights still on.
The exact electricity used by every room.
The cost of replacing each switch.
They recorded lights that were still on, but did not measure electricity use.
记录对象是空教室亮灯情况，并未直接测量电量。
选项把未测量的电量说成了精确记录。
报告没有测算更换开关的费用。
When were the reminder cards first in place?
Tuesday morning.
Monday after the check.
Wednesday evening.
on Tuesday morning.
原文明确周二早上贴卡。
周一记录不能当成贴卡时间。
周三已是第三次检查日，不是贴卡开始日。
Why is the report cautious about the cards' effect?
Room use and personal reminders also differed.
No lights were found on during the check.
Every room was used in exactly the same way.
Different clubs used the rooms on different days, and some volunteers reminded classmates in person.
其他条件也变化，不能单独归因于提醒卡。
三天分别有八、五、四间，不是零。
exactly the same 与不同社团使用的事实相反。
Which statement is supported?
The team needs more information to estimate energy saved.
Electricity use fell by exactly half.
The cards have been proved to work in every school.
Any estimate of energy saved would need more information.
记录的房间数不能直接等同于节电量。
八间降到四间不代表耗电量精确减半。
只有一所学校的初步观察，也未排除其他条件。

reading.text: An empty station room became a small photograph display. At first, the student guides called it 'a story of progress'. Most old pictures showed muddy paths and crowded market stalls; the new pictures showed wide roads and bright buildings. During a trial visit, an older resident stopped beside a market photograph. She remembered how neighbours met there and helped each other carry things home. 'The path was difficult in the rain,' she said, 'but the market was also a place where people knew me.' The guides did not remove the new photographs. They added short accounts from several residents, with permission, and changed the opening label. It now invited visitors to compare gains, losses and different memories. The room showed more than one way of experiencing the same changes.
items: How did the guides first present the photographs?
As a story of progress.
As a history of the whole country.
As proof that old markets were always better.
the student guides called it 'a story of progress'.
开头明确初始框架是进步故事。
一间车站展室的地方照片不是整个国家的历史。
always better 与初始强调新路和新建筑的方向相反。
What did the resident add to the discussion?
A memory of social connection at the old market.
A claim that the path was easy in every season.
A request to remove every new photograph.
the market was also a place where people knew me.
她补充了旧集市中人与人的联系。
她明说雨天路难走。
她没有要求移除新照片，团队后来也保留了。
Why did the guides change the opening label?
The original framing missed some residents' experiences.
The old and new photographs showed different towns.
They could no longer obtain permission for any account.
compare gains, losses and different memories.
新标签承认收益、失去的东西和不同记忆，使原先单一框架更完整。
文中讨论同一地方的变化，没有换成不同城镇。
他们是获得许可后加入居民叙述，不是全部无法取得许可。
Which summary best reflects the final display?
Changes can be understood through different people's experiences.
New buildings make every resident feel the same way.
One resident's memory replaces all other evidence.
more than one way of experiencing the same changes.
结尾强调同一变化可被不同人以不同方式体验。
every 和 same 过度概括，正与多种体验相反。
加入的是多位居民叙述，且保留了其他照片证据。

task.text:
PHOTO LABEL CHECKLIST
For each photograph, record its source and the permission for the planned use. If a date is an estimate, use wording such as 'around 1980' rather than presenting 1980 as certain. Keep the original caption in your records, even if the display uses a shorter label. A corrected label should state what changed and why. Do not erase the earlier record; it helps explain how the information was checked.
items: Each photograph needs a record of its source and _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
permission
record its source and the permission for the planned use.
来源和具体用途的许可要分别记录。
For an estimated year, a word such as _____ shows the uncertainty. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
around
use wording such as 'around 1980'
around 表大约，不能把估计年份写成完全确定。
Do not _____ the earlier record after a correction. 从原文中填一个动词原形。
erase
Do not erase the earlier record
修正后保留旧记录，才能说明核对过程。

writing.stem: 写一份约90—110词的英文项目报告。你们在三个放学后检查空教室，亮灯的教室数依次为8、5、4间；周二早上贴了提醒卡，但房间使用情况和现场提醒也不同。概述发现，说明不能由此直接声称节电量减半，并提出两条后续核对办法。不要编造用电量。
writing.model: Our team checked empty classrooms after the final lesson on three school days. We found lights on in eight rooms, then five, then four. Reminder cards were added on Tuesday morning, but different clubs used the rooms and some students gave reminders in person. We therefore cannot say that the cards alone caused the change or that electricity use fell by half. Next, we should record how each room is used and keep the reminder conditions similar during another check. We would also need information about the lights and how long they stay on before estimating energy saved.
points: 如实报告8、5、4间与提醒卡时间
说明其他条件也发生变化
区分亮灯房间数与实际节电量
提出两条具体后续核对办法
writing.organisation: 观察事实、结论边界和后续建议分层说明。
writing.language: 区分过去的观察与现在的判断、建议；检查数字与指代，避免无依据的确定语气。
writing.format: 报告有清楚主题，篇幅符合要求
writing.pitfall: 房间数减半不等于用电量减半，不能编造百分比节能结论。
